editorial:
Four teens stuck in detention find an old video game and get pulled into Jumanji as their avatars. Spencer turns into a fearless hero, Fridge becomes his loyal sidekick, Bethany becomes a map expert, and Martha becomes a tough fighter. The jungle is full of wild animals, dangerous levels, and funny surprises, so they have to work together if they want to survive and get home. The movie has a bright, playful vibe that makes the danger feel fun instead of scary.

The cast is the big win here. Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, and Karen Gillan have great chemistry, and their body-swap jokes land often. The action moves fast, with chase scenes, puzzles, and big set pieces that keep you entertained. Some jokes repeat and the story follows a familiar path, but the energy rarely drops. If you want a fun group movie night, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: By the end, the group reaches the final level and returns the stolen jewel to the statue, which breaks the curse and frees Jumanji. The villain is swallowed by the jungle, and the teens are pulled back into the real world. They destroy the game so nobody else can get trapped, then return to detention with a stronger bond and better attitudes. The twist is that their avatars’ skills and teamwork carry over into real life, making them more confident and changing how they see themselves and each other.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action comedies and group movie nights.
